Set up Syllabus (0.2.0 or later) in this project, which doesn't use it yet, then add these engineering rules.

From fabricahq/public-rules:
- The whole group techs/golang, including rules the library adds to it later
- The whole Testing group (practices/testing), including rules the library adds to it later
- The rule practices/testing/cover-boundary-cases, forked from version 1.0.0 as a local rule I can edit
- The rule techs/go/return-errors, forked from version 1.0.0 as a local rule I can edit

Run:
# From the root of your project

# Set up Syllabus
curl -fsSL https://code-rules.fabricahq.com/install.sh | sh
syllabus project init

# Add your rules
syllabus project add library fabrica \
  --repository https://github.com/fabricahq/public-rules.git \
  --groups techs/golang \
  --groups practices/testing

syllabus project sync

syllabus project add rule practices/testing/cover-boundary-cases \
  --from fabrica@1.0.0 \
  --reason 'We maintain our own version of this rule.'

syllabus project add rule techs/go/return-errors \
  --from fabrica@1.0.0

syllabus project build

Then make sure AGENTS.md tells agents to read .syllabus/generated/RULES.md. The rules move to newer versions only when someone runs syllabus project update and confirms.
